svg.title: Supervisor wordmark — horizontal lockup
svg.desc: Cropped from supervisor-wordmark.svg's three-lockup composite: only #lockup-horizontal falls inside this viewBox (y=0..287). The other two groups (#lockup-stacked, #wordmark-only) sit at y=288+ and y=819+ respectively and are clipped by the viewBox at render time. All text outlined from Inter Medium with -2% tracking. Symbol fill #2D7A4E, wordmark fill #0E0F11.
